args.query: Next.js 15 async request APIs: await params, cookies() and headers() in app router pages and route handlers

results.title: Next.js App Router + Stripe webhook handler
results.summary: A Next.js route handler that verifies Stripe webhook signatures from the raw body and handles checkout.session.completed.

results.title: Next.js 16 App Router route handler + Zod validation
results.summary: Validate JSON bodies and search params in a Next.js App Router route handler with Zod, returning typed 400s; tested by calling the handler with NextRequest.

results.title: Next.js middleware + Supabase SSR session refresh
results.summary: Refresh Supabase auth cookies in Next.js middleware with @supabase/ssr and redirect signed-out users away from protected routes.

results.title: Next.js 16 server actions + Zod with useActionState-shaped results
results.summary: A 'use server' form action that validates FormData with Zod and returns field errors in the shape useActionState expects, tested by calling the action directly.

results.title: NextAuth.js v4 credentials provider + JWT/session callbacks (mocked)
results.summary: NextAuth v4 authOptions for Next.js with a Credentials provider, bcrypt-checked users and role claims flowing through jwt and session callbacks, unit-tested without a server.

results.title: set-cookie-parser single and joined headers
results.summary: Parse single and array Set-Cookie headers with set-cookie-parser, split comma-joined headers using splitCookiesString, and assert name, value, path, httpOnly and sameSite fields offline.

results.title: React Router 8 data loaders and actions tested with createStaticHandler
results.summary: Route loaders and actions with redirects, validation errors and 404 responses in React Router's data APIs, tested offline with createStaticHandler and plain Requests.

results.title: graphql-request client with typed operations, mocked by MSW graphql handlers
results.summary: Call a GraphQL API with graphql-request (variables, headers, error handling) and test offline with MSW's graphql.link(url).query/mutation handlers (msw 3 API). Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because graphql-request 7 still peers on graphql 14 - 16, but the client passes its tests against graphql 17.

results.title: express 5 async error handling
results.summary: Use express 5 with supertest to forward rejected async handlers to a JSON error middleware, with router-level params, a JSON 404 handler and offline tests.

results.title: Starlette SessionMiddleware signed cookies with itsdangerous
results.summary: Add cookie sessions to a Starlette app via SessionMiddleware, then test login, tampering, logout, expiry and JSON safety fully offline over httpx ASGITransport.
